subject: c-cont
title: C.CONT.------SOC.RT.P.
description: Chart on book p. 282 (CMBA-38). C-CONT (composite continuance) is the subject; SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-SIGN (progressional significance), RT-IMP (reality implications), AFL (affinity alignment) and POL-P (political policies). From PROG-SIGN: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and INFO-ALGN (information alignment). From RT-IMP: TH-CONT (thrust continuance). From AFL: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From POL-P: TR (transformation).
